about: The page rules for the ten standing features that the engine (site_page.html_problems) and Peek's lib/sample-page.ts must agree on. Scripts: at most two inline, one menu toggle and one open-now badge; the badge's script (it reads Date or Intl.DateTimeFormat and data-hours) is at most 1,500 characters and has no network, storage or HTML writing (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, eval, import(), document.cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, navigator, location, sendBeacon, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, Function, postMessage, open(), caches, serviceWorker). Its data sits in exactly one data-hours attribute, at most 400 characters, and every time in it (HH:MM, 24:00 = 00:00) is one the facts' hours print (2PM = 14:00, 12AM = 00:00). Words in Hangul, kana or Chinese characters stand only as the facts or the row's map link (URL-decoded) print them. No reviewer's name on the page. 'refused' lists the kinds: script, hours-data, script-words, reviewer. A review card shows its reviewer's short name ("Sarah M.") beside its quote and nowhere else; never a full last name, never a reviewer's picture.
